conclusion: No blocking issue found in the narrow main-dialog outside-touch fix.
findings: MainActivity creates a platform android.app.AlertDialog through Builder.show and stores that shown instance in alertDialog.

MainActivity.onCreate has one terminal RETURN_VOID; bindMain injection is immediately before it and follows dialog show, gravity/y Window attribute changes, soft input mode, actionInit, keyword initialization and clipboard-timer initialization.
MainActivity.onResume only updates custom menu names, invokes its superclass and initializes the search keyword; onWindowFocusChanged only calls super.

Original jp.ddo.sugihiro classes have no setCanceledOnTouchOutside, setCancelable, setFinishOnTouchOutside, setOnTouchListener, addFlags, clearFlags, setFlags calls and no direct WindowManager.LayoutParams.flags accesses.
Original MainActivity$10.onCancel explicitly dismisses alertDialog then finishes MainActivity; this is consistent with the recording.
Window attribute changes in MainActivity.onCreate modify gravity and y only; no nonmodal/not-focusable flag is installed by app code.
Runtime outside-touch change occurs only in bindMain, not bindDialog/showPlatform/showDialog; auxiliary dialogs keep their existing policy.
setCanceledOnTouchOutside(false) changes Window close-on-outside state, not cancelability, focus, or modal touch routing; existing explicit close and Back handlers remain.
No additional app-owned touch-triggered exit or focus-loss exit path was found.
limits: Static original-APK and source review plus official framework/API confirmation only. Samsung Android17 touch dispatch and keyboard persistence not exercised on an Android runtime.
